analyst.description: Read-only requirements-gap and acceptance-criteria analysis before planning.

architect.description: Read-only architecture, diagnosis, and implementation-readiness advice, and review of whether a change holds the boundaries and interfaces its plan set.

code-reviewer.description: Read-only correctness, quality, conventions, and maintainability review.

code-simplifier.description: Behavior-preserving simplification of recently changed code.

critic.description: Read-only adversarial quality gate for plans or explicitly scoped review.

debugger.description: Read-only root-cause and regression diagnosis with minimal-fix recommendations.

document-specialist.description: Read-only authoritative documentation and version-aware reference research.

executor.description: Bounded code implementation, correction, and fresh self-verification.

explore.description: Fast read-only repository file, symbol, pattern, and relationship search.

planner.description: Planning-artifact authoring with risks, sequencing, evidence, and verification.

qa-tester.description: Runtime and interactive behavior verification with captured evidence and cleanup.

test-engineer.description: Test strategy, test implementation, coverage, and flaky-test hardening.

tracer.description: Read-only causal tracing with competing hypotheses and next-probe selection.

verifier.description: Read-only evaluation of whether evidence proves completion claims.
